card.name: Review dates and page-footer notices
card.fires_on: Words and digits in web page footers: the reviewer's name or year in a 'Review Date' line, and 'length' in the 'Materials may be edited for content and length' note.

modes.label: Review date lines
modes.description: The reviewer's first name or the final digit of the year in a 'Review Date' or 'Update Date' line.
modes.example: Review Date: 3/21/2010 Review By:<< Susan>> Storck, MD, FACOG

modes.label: Edit-notice footer
modes.description: The word 'length' ending the sentence 'Materials may be edited for content and length'.
modes.example: Note: Materials may be edited for content and<< length>>. For further information, please contact the

card.plain: It fires on the small standard text at the bottom of health web pages, such as review dates and the note that materials may be edited.
